title: Mixed Event — Beside Unchanging Warmth — Episode4 Cherish Your Feelings

meta.Event Outline: One day in December, Mizuki's sister sends word from abroad that she'll be coming to visit, to Mizuki's delight. Warm memories resurface, of a time long ago when the two of them went shopping together. And so, Mizuki extends an invitation to go once again.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line:
Where should we go first?
Any shops that you'd like to visit, Mizuki?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line: How about the decor shop we always go to? Oh, a new jewelry store seems to have opened up on the second floor. Why don't we go check that out?

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Mizuki
rows.Line:
(I wonder what it's like...
Maybe they have some cute stuff.)

rows.Speaker: Classmate B
rows.Line: But it's kinda weird that you're wearing it.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line: Then, let's have something sweet to eat...!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line:
I'll go buy us some crepes.
You sit tight here on this bench, okay?

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Mizuki
rows.Line: (She brought me here because she noticed that I wasn't feeling great...)

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Mizuki
rows.Line:
(The way they tell me...
It's like me being different means I don't belong there with them...)

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Mizuki
rows.Line: (That hurts so much... And it makes me feel so lonely...)

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Mizuki
rows.Line:
(The one-piece in that shop's window...
Is it new? It wasn't there when Sis and I went the other day.)

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Mizuki
rows.Line: (It's got so many bows and frills too...)

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Mizuki
rows.Line:
This is so cool!
These shoes and this ribbon are so adorable, and they even go perfectly with the blouse you made for me...!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line:
I'm back with the crepes!
I got you a strawberry one, Mizuki! I know it's your favorite!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line:
No, you're not weird.
Why are you asking such a thing...?

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Mizuki
rows.Line: Then, why's everyone else calling me that...?

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Mizuki
rows.Line:
The thing is...
I feel like I need to stop liking all the stuff that I think is cute.

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Mizuki
rows.Line: Because everyone will stop saying that I'm weird if I do... I won't have to feel this way anymore...

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Mizuki
rows.Line:
I really love those kinds of things...
And all the clothes that you make, Sis.

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Mizuki
rows.Line: I don't wanna say the opposite of that...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line: I had no idea this was bothering you so much. I really need to apologize for that...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line: And I understand what you're saying...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line:
Being put down by others...
Not being able to talk about the things you like... They both must be causing you so much pain.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line: But this is what I believe...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line: I think you should keep liking all the things you feel are cute...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line: That's what makes up who you are, right...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line:
I know...
They'll keep saying all those terrible things to you.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line: And to prevent that from happening, you might start to feel like you can't talk about the things you like as much...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line: But I don't think you should stop liking what you like to fit in with everyone else...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line: Because you're not weird at all, Mizuki...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line: I love how you love things that are cute.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line:
Which is why, Mizuki...
I want you to cherish your true feelings.

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Mizuki
rows.Line: (I can keep liking the things that I think are cute...?)

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Mizuki
rows.Line: (I am scared of what everyone else is gonna say...)

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Mizuki
rows.Line:
(But if Sis says that I'm not weird...
If she loves me the way that I am...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line:
Alright...
After we finish eating our crepes, would you mind tagging along as I shop for a few things?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line: I've been looking for the right buttons to use for this new outfit I've been designing.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line:
Yes, it's going to be for myself...
But I also want to make it so you really like it too, Mizuki!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line: Which is why I need you to tell me more about all the things you like.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Some really awful things happened to me after that...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (I even tried not being myself because they just kept sapping away at my energy.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (But because Sis said back then that it's okay for me to cherish my true feelings...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Despite all the things that did end up happening to me, I still like all the cute stuff I did back then.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
No, nothing's wrong...!
I was just reminiscing about the past a little.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I always had so much fun going out shopping with you while wearing the clothes that you made.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line: Hehe. I did make quite a lot just for you.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line: Oh yeah, remember how you used to stare into my room while I was on my sewing machine? That was always so cute.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line:
Of course I remember!
You made me so happy every time you told me the buttons and frills I chose to use were cute.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Well... That's enough about me.
Lemme hear more about what you've been up to, Sis!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I have so many questions that I wanna ask you! How have things been over there? What's work been like?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line:
Hehe. Okay.
Where should I start?
